symptom: `mxcli check` reports MDL-FLOW02 "merge rejoin1: nothing joins it" when the only `join rejoin1;` sits in the custom error handler of a `call rest service` — the retry loop of Studio Pro-authored OIDC.GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE and AWSAuthentication.POST_v1_GetCallerIdentity_ValidateCredentials (Evora, 0 errors under mx check), so exec refused their describe output
cause: getErrorHandlerBody (validate.go) kept its own type switch of statements with an ON ERROR clause and had drifted: no RestCallStmt, SendRestRequestStmt, CallWorkflowStmt, mapping statements, commit, delete, … Every walk built on it — merge/join labels, reference collection, import-mapping range, layout lanes — skipped those handler bodies
insight: The adapters table already existed precisely because per-walk lists drift (its comment says so, citing MDL076); this was a fifth copy nobody had pointed at it. When a rule misses a construct inside a handler, grep for every accessor of ErrorHandling.Body before patching the one switch in front of you. The control that the rule still fires (merge with no join anywhere) is in the same test file
